summary: The AgencyDocuments system manages documents and associated sub-disciplines, sites, and destinations within the HSPnet framework. It facilitates document editing, creation, and deletion, along with handling user permissions and settings for disciplines and destinations.
purpose: To manage document operations including creation, editing, deleting, and applying specific disciplines, sites, and destinations related to agency profiles.

workflows.name: Document Management
steps: Load document details and settings from user session and database.
Setup sites and destinations based on user permissions and selections.
Modify or add document details using forms and data fields.
Handle file uploads and assign corresponding settings.

workflows.name: Sub-discipline Management
steps: Setup the list of allowed disciplines based on user permissions.
Assign document sub-disciplines and validate entries.
Manage sub-discipline filters and visibility settings.

business_rules: Documents must adhere to the user's discipline permissions.
Sections must be updated dynamically based on data changes.
Document types can be restricted based on predefined omission codes.
validations: Validation for file upload to ensure non-empty file content.
calculations: SetupDisciplines function calculates allowance based on available disciplines.
ValueList converts ListBox items to a comma-separated list of values.
conditions: Check if a document is editable or not before displaying controls.
Determine section changes based on hidden fields and document data.
system_behavior: Auto-hide panels that do not have valid data or conditions.
Recompute visibility and settings based on user selections and session status.
Redirect users after save/delete operations to update views correctly.
dependencies: HSPnetSession for user authentication and session management.
DataLayer for database operations related to documents.
exceptions: HandleUploadedFile function handles empty file scenarios gracefully.
Session null checks to cancel data operations if the user session is not active.
